description: Native material definitions; reserved import bytes are not editable properties. The workshop adds a result material's strength, intelligence and agility to the result's base stats. No game code reads the class, affinity or max_dp values: items carry their own ratings and DP.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stable material definition identity.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Informational plain-text label; not a key or gameplay value.

columns.name: legacy_id
columns.description: Compatibility kind for existing inventory, saves and palettes; not a definition field-width limit.
